note: Date of service, per page: (1) a label below that starts within the first or last edge_words words of the page, with a date right after it (within label_reach_chars, only label_gap_words words between, so 'Visit Date: | DOB: 01/02/1960' is not a DOS) — an encounter label wins, else admit is From and discharge To; (2) else the key/value extractor's date; (3) else Azure OpenAI when enabled, on pages matching clinical_cues; (4) else no date. Each page keeps its own date and the Final DOS is the same. Edit labels here, not in dos_logic.py. Reloads on change.
note_default: DOS_DEFAULT_DATE is shown for a page with no date of its own (doc-level columns, review-ui downloads). It is never a page's Extracted DOS; it is the Final DOS of a stand-alone non-visit document (continuity_canon.json default_final_dos).
note_cues: Regex patterns. clinical_cues gates the Azure OpenAI fallback; discharge_cues makes it ask for admission and discharge dates.
